findings.title: Unrelated audit log pagination changes break on datetime ordering and unknown `paginate` argument
findings.body:
`OrganizationAuditLogsEndpoint.get` appears to contain unrelated changes for `OptimizedCursorPaginator` that will fail at runtime when `optimized_pagination=true` is passed by a superuser or global-access member:

1. `self.paginate(...)` does not accept an `enable_advanced_features` keyword argument (paginator constructor kwargs are not forwarded as arbitrary kwargs by `Endpoint.paginate`), causing a `TypeError`.
2. `OrganizationAuditLogsEndpoint` orders by `-datetime` (`DateTimeField`), but `OptimizedCursorPaginator` implements `Paginator`'s numeric `get_item_key` (`math.floor(value)` / `math.ceil(value)`) and `value_from_cursor` instead of `DateTimePaginator`'s timestamp conversion, which raises `TypeError: must be real number, not datetime.datetime` when serializing cursors.

findings.title: Allowing negative cursor offsets in QuerySet slicing raises `ValueError`
findings.body: Both `BasePaginator.get_result` (when `cursor.is_prev` is true and `cursor.offset < 0`) and `OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_result` (lines 877-886) pass a negative `start_offset` directly into `queryset[start_offset:stop]`. Django `QuerySet` slicing does not support negative indices and immediately raises `ValueError: Negative indexing is not supported.`, resulting in an unhandled 500 error whenever a client supplies a cursor string with a negative offset (e.g. `cursor=0:-5:1`).
